summary: Authenticate docs deployment notifications with a short-lived Site CI GitHub App token instead of a PAT.

rules.detail: No Fractal permission changes; the dispatch token is scoped to the website repository with Contents: write.

compatibility.detail: The repository dispatch event remains fractal-docs-changed.

manual.detail: Configure the Fractal repository's SITE_CI_APP_ID variable and SITE_CI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY Actions secret for the Site CI App; its target repository installation needs Contents: write.
